<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the unknown sample. The most direct way is to obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum, which shows signals for methyl protons. By counting distinct methyl signals (typically singlets, doublets, etc.) we can infer the number of methyl groups. The tool `proton_nmr_spectra` provides the ¹H NMR spectrum for the sample. No additional arguments are required. We'll request the spectrum and then analyze it to count methyl signals.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
